news.title: Strait of Hormuz must remain closed as 'tool to pressure enemy,' Iran's new supreme leader says
news.description: Iran's new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei has said all U.S. military bases in the Middle East should close immediately as those bases will be attacked.

news.title: Trump tariffs: Martin Heinrich bill would give families tax rebate for higher import costs
news.description: The Supreme Court in a 6-3 ruling Feb. 20 ruled that President Donald Trumps IEEPA tariffs were illegal.

news.title: Housing affordability bill clears Senate as investor ban creates headaches
news.description: The Senate passed the bill 89-10, but House lawmakers say more changes are needed before it could go to President Donald Trump's desk.
